id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1001: "I'm Oral and this is Orel. As you can see, we're twins.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1028: "I'm Oral and this is Orel. As you can see, we're twins.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1009: "Twins have a mysterious power. We can tell what the other is thinking without saying a word.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1015: "Mother says it's because our life leaves on Yggdrasil are one for the two of us.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1030: "Are you the guest student everyone's talking about? Hmm, just silky hair; you're a more ordinary boy than I imagined.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|103e: "My sister Orel would say the same. We're twins, after all.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|104e: "I'm Oral and this is Orel. As you can see, we're twins.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1056: "Yggdrasil fell, and we could die any time, so Orel and I made a promise.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1062: "If Orel dies, I'll become Orel. Then we'll be together forever.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1077: "Yaaawn. The teacher's lessons are too easy and boring~.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|107e: "After all, I'm a genius girl. My first cry was a poem of heaven and earth creation in ancient Erdrea language.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|108a: "Of course, I don't remember that or the poem at all now. Geniuses are like that.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|109a: "Big sister Iris is really good at reading books, and she reads to me before bedtime.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10a4: "Tonight's book is the Headmaster's Dreamy Poems. This book is unacceptable. It's so boring.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10c6: "This one piece of cloth I'm sewing becomes tomorrow's meals and clothes for my little brothers back home...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10e6: "This one piece of cloth I'm sewing becomes tomorrow's meals and clothes for my little brothers back home...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1136: "This one piece of cloth I'm sewing becomes tomorrow's meals and clothes for my little brothers back home...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10d4: "So I have no time to sleep. Tonight I must sew twenty more of these...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10f4: "But since Yggdrasil fell, I haven't heard a word from my little brothers back home...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|111b: "My little brothers wrote. They said something about a golden iceberg, but they must have had a bad dream.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|112c: "Well then, time to work hard at sewing again today. I have no time to sleep.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1152: "My grandma is a botanist, and as a child she attended this school just like me.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|117c: "My grandma is a botanist, and as a child she attended this school just like me.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11a5: "My grandma is a botanist, and as a child she attended this school just like me.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|115e: "Grandma called this tree the vessel of Yggdrasil's memories. What could that mean?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1187: "Grandma called this tree the vessel of Yggdrasil's memories. What could that mean?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11b1: "Grandma called this tree the vessel of Yggdrasil's memories. What could that mean?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|116a: "My goal is to unravel this tree's mystery before graduation and become a botanist.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1193: "My goal is to unravel this tree's mystery before graduation and become a botanist.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11bd: "My goal is to unravel this tree's mystery before graduation and become a botanist.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11d4: "My lovely lady is Lady Massive, whom I met at the Octagonia arena on a day off, darling!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11e1: "I copied her speech and moves, but her wonderful body is far off, so I'm training hard, darling!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1201: "I copied her speech and moves, but her wonderful body is far off, so I'm training hard, darling!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11f4: "No time to rest even at night, darling! My lovely lady is Lady Massive, whom I met in Octagonia!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1215: "As expected of the Academy's first boy guest student. Coming to the girls' dorm this late is so bold, darling.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1223: "Hehe, you somehow resemble my idol, so I like you very much, darling.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1237: "Since Yggdrasil fell, my classmates have noticed how wonderful muscle training is!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1243: "Now we sweat together every day! I'm so moved, darling!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|124e: "Idolizing Lady Massive, training alone in a corner of the school was a bit lonely, darling!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1265: "I have no special traits, but I really wanted to enroll here, so I studied super hard.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|128d: "I have no special traits, but I really wanted to enroll here, so I studied super hard.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1272: "After all, the uniform here is designed by the hugely popular designer Calvin Jeanpolte.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|127c: "My dream is to graduate, apprentice under Jeanpolte, and become a super designer.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12a5: "My dream is to graduate, apprentice under Jeanpolte, and become a super designer.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1299: "After all, this school-issue nightgown is designed by the hugely popular designer Calvin Jeanpolte.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12ba: "W-wait, I wasn't running in the hall! I was speed walking! My speed walking is super fast!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12c9: "Wow! The rumored one in person! The first guest student in Medal Academy history! And a boy! Wow, amazing!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12de: "...There was a girl in the study room. She only comes to school at night. She said let's play together.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12ed: "So I thought I'd go meet her and sneaked out of my room. ...Because I promised her.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12fe: "She was really there! I'm not lying! At night, by the study room window, there was a girl!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1308: "When I spoke to her she smiled and said let's play together!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1313: "Mom, Dad... Sniff... I miss you. I want to go home...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|132b: "As a tidy person, I can't stand how dusty this school's library is.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1337: "Supposedly there are lots of valuable books about the school, but they're all old, musty, and dirty.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1346: "To someone curious like you, traveler, it might be a treasure trove, though.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1355: "The night Toki left a book in the study room, I went with her, remember? No other students were there.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1367: "You must have had a strange dream. Don't wander the school at night for that. Go to your room and sleep quietly.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|137a: "A boy freely walking around this academy... You might be the first. Are you an acquaintance of the Headmaster?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|138b: "Hmm. Well, either way. You're my first boy friend. Since we've met, be nice to me.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|139d: "Since the day Yggdrasil fell, the little ones have been acting strange. They never cried at night before.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13ac: "These kids must be sensing the grown-ups' anxiety. We older girls must be strong.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13bd: "Yggdrasil is back in the sky, and I feel so good! Cleaning is going great!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13cc: "The moment Yggdrasil returned, this kid went back to pranks! Being too lively is a problem!

id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1724: "I'm Iris, the student council president. The students here are all oddballs, and my stomach hurts every day.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1736: "The other day, junior Nontoto chased a paradise bird holding a silver gem and got lost.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1746: "Had she entered Roc's Ravine, she wouldn't have been safe. Ugh, thinking about it gives me stomach pain again...!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|175a: "Tiny medal, tiny medal. Swap them and the medal is unlucky. Not so; good things happen.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1762: "Tomorrow's wind blows tomorrow. After all, you're lucky. You met a tiny medal.

id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|182a: "She holds back her tears so we won't worry. Such a kind, brave girl...

id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19b0: "Hey, Dahlia. What do you think I'm thinking right now?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19b7: "Oh, what? The lily-of-the-valley fairy you dreamed of? Or a ball in some distant foreign land?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19c6: "You know already... you're mean. While I look at you, I'm not clever enough to think of anything but you.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19d3: "Hehe... Wise. You're such a wonderful fool.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19e2: "Hey, Dahlia. I don't want to sleep yet. Do you know why?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19e9: "Oh, Wise, are you afraid of nightmares? Like a first-year who just enrolled.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19f4: "Dahlia, no. While I'm asleep I can't see you. I can't bear that pain.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19ff: "Wise, you cute fool. Just dream of me. Then we can be together always.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a13: "Dahlia, lately I think: so many people in the world suffer, can I live happily...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a22: "Wise, what's this suddenly? We're still children. Powerless ones can do nothing now.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a2f: "I know nothing of the world. How foolish. ...Is it okay for me to be here?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a39: "Wise, we will become adults someday. Don't be hasty. So for now, stay by my side.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a49: "Since Yggdrasil fell, my spirits have been low. I don't feel like talking to anyone.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a57: "Things got awkward with Dahlia too, and I'm truly sorry. I don't know what to do myself.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a6b: "Hey, Dahlia. I'm afraid of graduating. Just thinking about a world where no one knows me makes my legs freeze.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1aa4: "Hey, Dahlia. I'm afraid of graduating. Just thinking about a world where no one knows me makes my legs freeze.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a78: "Hehe, you fool. Do you think I'd leave you alone? We're one together, aren't we?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ab1: "Hehe, you fool. Do you think I'd leave you alone? We're one together, aren't we?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a82: "Ah! Sorry, Dahlia! I underestimated you. I promise... we won't part.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1abb: "Ah! Sorry, Dahlia! I underestimated you. I promise... we won't part.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a8d: "After graduation let's travel the world. However wide it is, with the two of us, I'm not afraid.

id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ccf: "The most important thing for a delinquent is never to cause trouble for someone who looked out for you.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cdb: "And yet look at me, what a mess. I carelessly threw away the pointer my homeroom teacher, Ms. Michiyo, treasured.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ce8: "Ms. Michiyo looks gentle, but she's terrifying when angry. If she finds out, who knows what punishment awaits...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cf5: "I'd replace it, but that pointer was custom, made with the Fun-Sized Forge. Impossible for a delinquent like me.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d05: "...Hey, traveler bro. After your long adventures, you've reached this academy, so maybe you can do the Fun-Sized Forge?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d13: "If you can, could you make a fine whip to be Ms. Michiyo's new pointer in my place?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d2a: "...Never mind, I was out of my mind. Having someone else settle my own score is unworthy of a delinquent.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d36: "I'll take Ms. Michiyo's scary punishment squarely and settle it...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d4c: "As expected of you, traveler bro! I checked the library books and found a good whip recipe. Use it!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d5f: "Sorry for the demands, but make a Queen's whip+1 or better. Give the teacher a fine whip to show sincerity.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1da7: "Sorry for the demands, but make a Queen's whip+1 or better. Give the teacher a fine whip to show sincerity.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d70: "You probably know, but the Queen's whip is the teacher's, so don't equip it, bro!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1db8: "You probably know, but the Queen's whip is the teacher's, so don't equip it, bro!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d7b: "Well then, I'm counting on you, traveler bro. Let me settle my score!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d8e: "If Ms. Michiyo finds out about the whip, even a delinquent like me can't endure the harsh punishment waiting.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d99: "But if I show sincerity and apologize, Ms. Michiyo will surely forgive me. For that I absolutely need the Queen's whip.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dc3: "Well then, I'm counting on you, traveler bro. Let me settle my score!

tm.「あたしがオラルで こっちがオレル。\n あたしたち 見ての通りの双子なの。: "I'm Oral and this is Orel. As you can see, we're twins.
tm.「双子って 不思議なチカラがあってね。\n おたがいの 考えてることが\n 言葉: "Twins have a mysterious power. We can tell what the other is thinking without saying a word.
tm.「母さまが言うには 命の大樹にある\n あたしたちの 命の葉っぱが\n ふたりで: "Mother says it's because our life leaves on Yggdrasil are one for the two of us.
tm.「あなたが ウワサの客員生徒さんなの？\n ふーん 髪が サラサラなだけで\n: "Are you the guest student everyone's talking about? Hmm, just silky hair; you're a more ordinary boy than I imagined.
tm.「姉のオレルも そう言うはずだよ。\n だって あたしたち 双子なんだから。: "My sister Orel would say the same. We're twins, after all.
tm.「あたしがオラルで この子がオレル。\n あたしたち 見ての通りの双子なの。: "I'm Oral and this is Orel. As you can see, we're twins.
tm.「大樹が地面に落っこちて\n あたしたちも いつ死んじゃうかわからないから\n: "Yggdrasil fell, and we could die any time, so Orel and I made a promise.
tm.「オレルが死んだら あたしが オレルになるの。\n それなら ふたりは ずっと一: "If Orel dies, I'll become Orel. Then we'll be together forever.
tm.「ふわ～。先生のじゅぎょうは\n カンタンすぎて つまらないですね～。: "Yaaawn. The teacher's lessons are too easy and boring~.
tm.「なんたって わたしは天才少女。\n わたしのうぶ声は こだいロトゼタシア語の\: "After all, I'm a genius girl. My first cry was a poem of heaven and earth creation in ancient Erdrea language.
tm.「もちろん その時のことも 詩のことも\n いまじゃあ まったく おぼえてません: "Of course, I don't remember that or the poem at all now. Geniuses are like that.
tm.「アイリスおねえさまは ご本をよむのが\n とーっても おじょうずで\n おねん: "Big sister Iris is really good at reading books, and she reads to me before bedtime.
tm.「今日の ご本は メダル校長のユメイロポエム。\n この ご本は いただけません: "Tonight's book is the Headmaster's Dreamy Poems. This book is unacceptable. It's so boring.
tm.「私が ぬっている この１枚の布が\n 故郷に残した 弟たちの\n 明日のごはん: "This one piece of cloth I'm sewing becomes tomorrow's meals and clothes for my little brothers back home...
tm.「なれば 眠っているヒマなど ありませぬ。\n 今夜のうちに あと２０枚\n こ: "So I have no time to sleep. Tonight I must sew twenty more of these...
tm.「しかし 故郷に残した 弟たちからの連絡は\n 命の大樹が 地に落ちてからという: "But since Yggdrasil fell, I haven't heard a word from my little brothers back home...
tm.「故郷に残した弟たちから 連絡が来ました。\n 黄金の氷山が どうこう言っていま: "My little brothers wrote. They said something about a golden iceberg, but they must have had a bad dream.
tm.「さあ それでは 今日も今日とて\n おさいほうに はげむとします。\n 眠って: "Well then, time to work hard at sewing again today. I have no time to sleep.
tm.「ワタシのおばあちゃまは しょくぶつ学者で\n 子供のころは ワタシと おんなじ: "My grandma is a botanist, and as a child she attended this school just like me.
tm.「おばあちゃまは この木のことを\n 大樹さまの記憶のうつわと 言っていました。: "Grandma called this tree the vessel of Yggdrasil's memories. What could that mean?
tm.「学校をソツギョウするまでに\n この木の フシギをときあかして\n しょくぶつ: "My goal is to unravel this tree's mystery before graduation and become a botanist.
tm.「ワタクシにとっての ステキなレディは\n お休みの日に グロッタの闘技場で出会: "My lovely lady is Lady Massive, whom I met at the Octagonia arena on a day off, darling!
tm.「しゃべり方と 動きをマネしたけれど\n あの ステキなボディには ほど遠いから: "I copied her speech and moves, but her wonderful body is far off, so I'm training hard, darling!
tm.「夜でも 休んでるヒマは ないですわよーん！\n ワタクシの目標とする ステキな: "No time to rest even at night, darling! My lovely lady is Lady Massive, whom I met in Octagonia!
tm.「さすがは 学園初 男子の客員生徒さん。\n こんな夜ふけに 女子寮へ やってく: "As expected of the Academy's first boy guest student. Coming to the girls' dorm this late is so bold, darling.
tm.「うふふ どことなく ワタクシのあこがれの人に\n 似ているような 気がしますし: "Hehe, you somehow resemble my idol, so I like you very much, darling.
tm.「命の大樹が 落っこちてから\n ご学友の皆さまが 筋トレのすばらしさに\n お: "Since Yggdrasil fell, my classmates have noticed how wonderful muscle training is!
tm.「今では こうして 共に汗を流す日々！\n ワタクシ とても感動しておりますわー: "Now we sweat together every day! I'm so moved, darling!
tm.「レディ・マッシブさまに あこがれ\n 校舎のすみで ひとり 身体を鍛えるのは\: "Idolizing Lady Massive, training alone in a corner of the school was a bit lonely, darling!
tm.「私 これといった個性は ないけれど\n どうしても この学校に入りたくて\n: "I have no special traits, but I really wanted to enroll here, so I studied super hard.
tm.「なんてったって ここの制服は\n かの 超人気デザイナー\n カルバン・ジャン: "After all, the uniform here is designed by the hugely popular designer Calvin Jeanpolte.
tm.「卒業したら ジャンポルテに弟子入りして\n スーパーデザイナーになるのが 私の: "My dream is to graduate, apprentice under Jeanpolte, and become a super designer.
tm.「なんたって 学校指定の このネグリジェは\n かの 超人気デザイナー\n カル: "After all, this school-issue nightgown is designed by the hugely popular designer Calvin Jeanpolte.
tm.「わっ…わたし ろうかを走ってませんよ！\n はやあるきをしてたんですよ！\n: "W-wait, I wasn't running in the hall! I was speed walking! My speed walking is super fast!
tm.「わあっ！ ウワサの本人 ごとうじょう！\n メダ女史上 はじめての客員生徒！\: "Wow! The rumored one in person! The first guest student in Medal Academy history! And a boy! Wow, amazing!
tm.「……自習室に 女の子がいたの。\n その子は 夜しか学校に来なくてね。\n い: "...There was a girl in the study room. She only comes to school at night. She said let's play together.
tm.「だから 会いにいってあげようと思って\n お部屋をこっそり ぬけだしたの。\n: "So I thought I'd go meet her and sneaked out of my room. ...Because I promised her.
tm.「ホントにいたの！ ウソじゃないもん！\n 夜にね。このじしゅうしつの マドのと: "She was really there! I'm not lying! At night, by the study room window, there was a girl!
tm.「話しかけたら ニコっと笑ってね。\n いっしょに あそぼうって言ったのよ！: "When I spoke to her she smiled and said let's play together!
tm.「おかあさん おとうさん……\n グス……会いたいの。\n わたし お家に かえ: "Mom, Dad... Sniff... I miss you. I want to go home...
tm.「キレイ好きな 私としては\n この学校の図書室は ホコリっぽくって\n どうし: "As a tidy person, I can't stand how dusty this school's library is.
tm.「なんでも この学校に関する貴重な本が\n たくさん置いてあるらしいんだけど\n: "Supposedly there are lots of valuable books about the school, but they're all old, musty, and dirty.
tm.「旅人さんみたいに 探究心のある人には\n 宝の山かもしれないけれどね。: "To someone curious like you, traveler, it might be a treasure trove, though.
tm.「トキちゃんが 自習室に ご本を忘れた夜は\n 私が 一緒に取りにいってあげたで: "The night Toki left a book in the study room, I went with her, remember? No other students were there.
tm.「きっと あなたは おかしな夢を見たのよ。\n そんな理由で 夜中に学校をうろつ: "You must have had a strange dream. Don't wander the school at night for that. Go to your room and sleep quietly.
tm.「この学園を 自由に歩きまわる男の子なんて\n あなたが はじめてじゃないかしら: "A boy freely walking around this academy... You might be the first. Are you an acquaintance of the Headmaster?
tm.「ふ～ん。まあ どっちでもいいわ。\n あなたは 私の はじめての男友達よ。\n: "Hmm. Well, either way. You're my first boy friend. Since we've met, be nice to me.
tm.「命の大樹が 地に落ちた日から\n 小さな子たちの様子が おかしいの。\n 夜泣: "Since the day Yggdrasil fell, the little ones have been acting strange. They never cried at night before.
tm.「きっと 大人たちの 不安な気持ちを\n この子たちは 感じてしまってるのよ。\: "These kids must be sensing the grown-ups' anxiety. We older girls must be strong.
tm.「命の大樹が 空に戻って\n なんだか とっても いい気分！\n おそうじが は: "Yggdrasil is back in the sky, and I feel so good! Cleaning is going great!
tm.「大樹さまが 戻ってきたとたんに\n この子ったら また イタズラざんまい！\n: "The moment Yggdrasil returned, this kid went back to pranks! Being too lively is a problem!
tm.「私 メダ女新聞部 部長のメープル……。\n 時間をかけて作った カベ新聞が\n: "I'm Maple, head of the Medal Academy newspaper club... The wall newspaper I spent ages on got blown away by a gust.
tm.「今号の特集コーナーは\n ルージュ先生の 恋のお悩み相談室で\n みんなが 楽: "This issue's feature was Ms. Rouge's love advice corner, and everyone was looking forward to it...
tm.「これから 刷りなおすのは ムリだから\n 今回は あきらめて 次号の発行を目指: "It's impossible to reprint, so I'll give up this time and aim for the next issue. Sigh... I was so proud of this one...
tm.「新聞を読みにきてくれたなら ごめんなさい。\n もう 今号の発行は あきらめて: "If you came to read the paper, sorry. I gave up on this issue and have started a new one.
tm.「どうしても 読みたいんなら\n 申し訳ないけど 自分で探しにいってね。: "If you really want to read it, sorry, but you'll have to look for it yourself.
tm.「新聞は 怪鳥の幽谷のほうに 飛んでったから\n 運がよければ 谷にある どこか: "The paper flew toward Roc's Ravine, so with luck it may be stuck on a signboard somewhere in the valley.
tm.「……え？ なんで わかるのかって？\n だって あの新聞は 私が書いた最高傑作: "...Huh? How do I know? Because that paper is my masterpiece! It won't just disappear easily!
tm.「あたしは この学校で いちばんの読書家よ！\n 図書室にある 本だったら\n: "I'm the best reader in this school! I've read every book in the library!
tm.「最近の おススメは 怪鳥の宝玉って本なの！\n メダル女学園の 東にある谷に暮: "My latest pick is the book Roc's Gems! It records the habits of the paradise birds in the valley east of here!
tm.「生徒指導のマリンヌ先生には 気をつけて。\n あの人は クチうるさい人で\n: "Beware of Ms. Marinne, the student guidance teacher. She's a nag, very strict about appearance and attitude.
tm.「それでなくても あなたは 男の子だし\n あの人の前で あんまり\n ハメをは: "On top of that, you're a boy, so don't go overboard in front of her.
tm.「どうも こんばんは 客員生徒さん。\n こんなに遅くまで 冒険しているなんて\: "Good evening, guest student. Adventuring this late, you have it rough too.
tm.「もしも 冒険の旅に 疲れたら\n ルージュ先生に 声をかけてみて。\n 私たち: "If you tire of adventuring, talk to Ms. Rouge. She'll probably give permission to stay in our dorm.
tm.「た…旅人さんみたいな かっこいい人と\n お お話しするのは きんちょうしちゃ: "T-talking to a cool person like you, traveler, makes me nervous, but I'll work hard...
tm.「そ…そんなに 近くに よらないで。\n あたし き きんちょうしちゃう……。: "D-don't come so close. I get n-nervous...
tm.「こ…こんな 夜中まで冒険なんて\n 旅人さんって た 大変なんだね。\n あた: "Adventuring this late at night, traveler, you h-have it rough. I'll cheer for you.
tm.「フレー フレー た 旅人さん。\n がんばれ……がんばれ……旅人さん。\n …: "Go, go, t-traveler. Do your best... do your best, traveler. ...Did I help a little?
tm.「私は 生徒会長のアイリスと申します。\n この学校の生徒たちは 変わり者ばかり: "I'm Iris, the student council president. The students here are all oddballs, and my stomach hurts every day.
tm.「この間も 下級生のノントトが\n 銀色の宝石を持った ごくらくちょうの\n 後: "The other day, junior Nontoto chased a paradise bird holding a silver gem and got lost.
tm.「もしも 怪鳥の幽谷に入っていたら\n あの子は 無事ではいられなかったでしょう: "Had she entered Roc's Ravine, she wouldn't have been safe. Ugh, thinking about it gives me stomach pain again...!
tm.「ちいさなメダル ちいさなメダル\n いれかえちゃうと さちないメダル\n そん: "Tiny medal, tiny medal. Swap them and the medal is unlucky. Not so; good things happen.
tm.「明日は 明日の 風が吹く。\n だって そうだろ キミはラッキー。\n ちいさ: "Tomorrow's wind blows tomorrow. After all, you're lucky. You met a tiny medal.
tm.「このポエムを ちょこっと読んであげれば\n どんな生徒でも すぐに眠ってくれる: "Read this poem to them a bit and any student falls asleep right away. It's a great help. As expected of the Headmaster.
tm.「私は 生徒会長のアイリスと申します。\n この学校の生徒たちは 変わり者ばかり: "I'm Iris, the student council president. The students here are all oddballs, and my stomach hurts every day...
tm.「もっぱらの悩みは くさった死体のコルトです。\n あの子は いつもステキな香り: "My main worry is Colt the rotting corpse. She always smelled lovely, but lately has a rotten smell.
tm.「私たちは そんなに気にしてないけれど\n 本人が ものすごく 落ち込んでしまっ: "We don't mind much, but she's taken it so hard she doesn't show up to class.
tm.「このところ 元気がなかった コルトは\n 何かよいことが あったみたいで\n: "Colt, who's been down lately, seems to have had some good news and smells much nicer than before.
tm.「誰か 心の お優しい方が\n 彼女を助けてくださったのね。\n なんて 親切な: "Some kind-hearted person must have helped her. What a thoughtful person.
tm.「メダルのメは 目ん玉のメ。\n その目で よ～く 世界を見れば\n キラッと: "Medal starts with an 'eye'. Look at the world with those eyes and you'll see that wonderful sparkle.
tm.「見つめてごらん じっくりと\n 探してごらん 大きな世界\n ちいさなメダルが: "Look closely, search the big world. Tiny medals are waiting for you.
tm.「このポエムを ちょこっと読んであげれば\n どんな生徒でも すぐに眠ってくれる: "Read this poem to them a bit and any student falls asleep right away. It's a great help. As expected of the Headmaster.
tm.「この子は きっと 悲しいことがあったのね。\n 今は 元気に見えるけれど\n: "This child must have had something sad happen. She looks fine now, but cries quietly when alone.
tm.「私たちに 心配かけまいと\n 涙を見せるのを ガマンしてるのよ。\n 優しくて: "She holds back her tears so we won't worry. Such a kind, brave girl...
